section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Psychological Flexibility Index Test (FIT-60), a validated Dutch 60-item self-report questionnaire. It details its six subscales, the 7-point Likert scale, and the handling of work-related items for elderly participants. The section reports a Cronbach's alpha of .93 for the FIT-60 in 'this study' and references a 'previous study' (Batink et al., 2012) which found a comparable internal consistency of .95, along with high convergent and moderate divergent construct validity.
